name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
value: US ~7,500 cases since 2025; PAHO decision due
summary: PAHO decision on whether the US has lost measles elimination is due soon; nearly 7,500 US cases and 11 deaths since 2025
state: PAHO experts met in closed session through 13 Nov to decide whether the US has lost the measles elimination status it has held since 2000, with a decision due to be announced in the coming days; nearly 7,500 US cases and 11 deaths have been reported since early 2025 (Reuters via News Tribune and CTV News, 11 Nov). PAHO had postponed the review from January (PAHO). Searches on 15 Nov found no published decision. Large outbreaks in high-income countries meet Watch.
for_you: Unvaccinated people, infants and those with weakened immunity are most exposed. In the UK, the NHS and UKHSA advise checking that children and adults have had two MMR doses.
rubric_hit: Watch: large outbreaks in high-income countries (US ~7,500 cases since 2025; elimination status under PAHO review)

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
